name: TPSSA
chinese: 任务判别信息保护的跨模态共享子空间对齐
private_folds: Use historical D4 checkpoint prototype_preparation.prototype_fold verbatim; verify against historical audit and prepare(). Private assignment historically used outer-train class/site balancing.

stage_a.model: read-only historical D4 best core plus explicit RP weights
stage_a.forward: exactly one native eval no-grad forward per fold on the PPU, all 871 transductive nodes; keep outer-train z_img only; no scoring logits
stage_a.diagnostic_rng: int(SHA256('911/{fold}/TPSSA/stage-a-native-forward')[:15],16) modulo 2**32; full state SHA recorded immediately before forward
stage_a.age_imputation: finite 0<age<=120; outer-train valid median; if none, fixed 17 years with explicit flag
stage_a.sex: CSV 1 male, 2 female, all other unknown; three one-hot columns
stage_a.site: outer-train vocabulary one-hot; missing explicit category; unseen reference/query category maps to all-zero at fitted vocabulary boundary
stage_a.probe_preprocessing: Outer-train phenotype encoding; each private reference then centers and scales input columns (ddof=0, constant scale=1). Identical site columns in site-only/full. Raw 16D targets reference-centered; predictions returned in original z units.
stage_a.ridge_intercept: reference centering, unpenalized intercept; alpha*I on every standardized non-intercept coefficient
stage_a.oof: for g=0,1,2 fit pf!=g, predict pf==g; same partitions and z for both probes
stage_a.null_permutation: joint age-sex, within historical private-fold x raw SITE_ID; random cycle derangement for n>=2; singleton unchanged; report index/age/sex/joint changed fractions; never diagnosis-stratified

gates.effective_rank: at least 7 outer folds have a valid rank>=1 direction in all three legal reference sets
gates.protection_fold_aggregation: all three reference directions must be valid and have squared protected norm>=0.20 in that outer fold

shared_direction.phenotype_coordinates: outer-train encoded age plus three sex indicators, then reference centered/scaled constant-safe
shared_direction.site_residualization: reference-centered one-hot site design, ridge alpha=1.0, unpenalized intercept; apply separately to standardized z_img and age/sex
shared_direction.disease_direction: reference ASD mean minus TD mean, in the same reference-standardized image coordinates; no query labels; epsilon=1e-12
shared_direction.protection: ||u-(u dot d)d||^2; both u,d unit vectors; zero d invalid, never random fallback

stage_b_preregistered.alignment_budget_policy: independent detached branch scales targeting 5% of native output-gradient norm, using actual protected image gradient; graph-connected zero for zero gradients; never a claim of 5% parameter-gradient budget
stage_b_preregistered.invalid_direction: graph-connected zero only for affected query private fold; log every inactive fold/epoch; NaN/Inf blocks task
stage_b_preregistered.checkpoint: strict improvement of native validation CE+Graph; native EarlyStopping equality behavior retained
stage_b_preregistered.test: keep train-end RNG, import best core without restoring best RNG; one grad-enabled native eval forward; no auxiliary execution; PPU softmax[:,0] and logits.argmax
stage_b_preregistered.gpu0: even outer folds only, 20 possible formal tasks
stage_b_preregistered.gpu1: odd outer folds only, 20 possible formal tasks
stage_b_preregistered.s4_permutation: fixed SHA local RNG, outer-train private-fold x site random cycle derangement; no diagnosis labels; W/u/d/P and native ph input untouched

summary: per-fold first, 10-fold mean and sample SD ddof=1
